design_rationale: Modeled a flexible e-commerce platform featuring an abstract Product base class, specialized concrete products, an interface for tax calculations, a customer-owned shopping cart, and a complete order and payment workflow.

entities.name: Product
entities.note: Base catalog item representing any sellable entity

entities.name: Taxable
entities.note: Interface defining behavior for tax-applicable items

entities.name: Customer
entities.note: Platform user who makes purchases and owns a shopping cart

entities.name: ShoppingCart
entities.note: Temporary container for items selected by the customer

entities.name: Order
entities.note: Finalized purchase contract generated from the shopping cart

entities.name: Payment
entities.note: Transaction record associated with an order
